days.title: The pitch
days.caption:
When a client tells me "we're drowning in admin", I ask one question: what are you paying a person to do that a computer should be doing?

Most of the time the answer is copy-paste. CRM to sheet, sheet to email, email to CRM. Every morning.

Here are four builds already doing that work: 47 invoices chased, 64 dead leads revived, 128 calls scored every week — running in n8n, in the client's own stack.

Book a fit call → inodepi.github.io

days.caption:
